picks.title: Microsoft releases new Nvidia-chip AI PCs with revamped Windows 11
picks.rationale: Microsoft's Surface Laptop Ultra launch on Nvidia RTX Spark, built to run local AI models and agents; the hardware headline of the Windows and Surface event, with specs and price.
picks.excerpt: Microsoft revealed the specs and price for its Surface Laptop Ultra, AI PCs that run on Nvidia chips that are designed to run AI models and agents.

picks.title: Microsoft is giving Copilot more control over Windows and your files
picks.rationale: A separate software announcement from the same event: Copilot gets local file access and can act across the OS under 'Hybrid Intelligence', which changes how people work in Windows day to day.
picks.excerpt: At today's Windows and Surface event, Microsoft showed off an upgrade to its Copilot AI system that will give it access to local files on your PC and the ability to take actions across the OS. picks.title: One UI 9 on the Galaxy S26 series: Here’s what’s changed
picks.rationale: One UI 9 (Android 17) reaches the Galaxy S26 line with new Galaxy AI tools: a concrete software release that changes what AI features millions of Samsung flagship users get, and the brief's only Android pick today.
picks.excerpt: One UI 9 brings Android 17 and several new features to the Galaxy S26, S26+, and S26 Ultra, including more Galaxy AI tools and additional customization options. picks.title: Tony Fadell on why the first wave of AI gadgets failed — and what comes next
picks.rationale: The iPod's creator explains why first-generation AI gadgets failed and what the next wave needs to earn trust: a useful product-design view for anyone designing AI hardware.
picks.excerpt: The “father of the iPod” says the first generation of AI gadgets failed to solve real problems — and the next wave will need to earn consumers’ trust.

picks.title: If Apple's AI suggestions in Messages annoys you, there's a solution
picks.rationale: New in the iOS 27.2 beta: settings that let users turn down Siri AI 'suggested actions' in Messages, a concrete change to how much control people have over AI in the UI.
picks.excerpt: The current beta of iOS 27.2 includes a Siri AI “suggested actions” feature in the Messages app that some will consider useful and others find annoying. A developer who has found a number of unannounced features has discovered that Apple is seeking to keep everyone happy with a new set of options.
